title: Births are difficult to predict even with rich survey and full-population register data
abstract: arXiv:2609.01194v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Major life events have proven difficult to predict. Does this reflect limits of theory, data, and algorithms, or the large role of chance? We examine one outcome - having a child within three years - through a near-ideal setting for prediction: a data challenge where 147 researchers predicted births for Dutch residents aged 18-45, using survey data and full-population registers. Methods ranged from logistic regression to a large language model and transformers. Predictions were moderately accurate (best F1: register 0.59, survey 0.76); advanced models did not outperform classical ones; and the larger registers did not beat the survey. Simulating the stochastic biology of conception and pregnancy, we estimated a predictive ceiling (survey F1 ~ 0.86-0.94, register 0.88-0.96). translated_title: 即使拥有丰富的调查数据和全人群登记数据，生育事件仍难以预测
translated_abstract: 重大生活事件已被证明难以预测。这究竟反映了理论、数据和算法的局限，还是偶然因素的重大作用？我们在一个近乎理想的预测环境中研究了“三年内生育”这一结果：一场数据挑战赛中，147名研究人员利用调查数据和全人群登记数据，预测18-45岁荷兰居民的生育情况。预测方法涵盖从逻辑回归到大语言模型和Transformer等。预测结果仅达到中等准确度（最佳F1分数：登记数据为0.59，调查数据为0.76）；先进模型并未超越经典模型；规模更大的登记数据也未能胜过调查数据。通过模拟受孕和怀孕的随机生物学过程，我们估计了预测上限（调查数据F1约为0.86-0.94，登记数据为0.88-0.96）。实际观察到的表现低于这一上限，这指向数据的不完善、方法的欠缺以及无法建模的偶然因素，而上限本身则表明生殖过程中的偶然性（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究通过147名研究人员的预测挑战赛发现，即使结合全人群登记数据、调查数据以及从经典统计模型到大语言模型的多种方法，对三年内生育的预测也只能达到中等准确度，且低于基于生殖随机性模拟的理论上限，表明重大生活事件的预测受限于数据缺陷、方法不足和固有偶然性。
en_tdlr: A data challenge with 147 researchers shows that predicting whether someone will have a child within three years remains only moderately accurate—even with full-population registers, survey data, and methods from logistic regression to LLMs—and falls short of a ceiling estimated from stochastic reproductive biology, revealing that imperfect data, methods, and inherent chance limit the predictability of major life events.
